title: Write lifecycle and termination safety
summary: Draft PR #20 contains a bounded write/release and termination safety candidate.
criteria: Verify simulation-only write and release handling, bounded termination, outcomes and startup/lifecycle protections scoped by draft PR #20.
Require independent review and exact-head Required CI, dedicated tag checks and handoff before merge.
proposal: PR #20 remains a draft; predecessor exact-head CI succeeded, but review found unresolved lifecycle gaps. The reconciled head requires fresh hosted CI.

history.summary: Reconciled legacy PR #20 with living roadmap main, preserved owner decisions D-02C4A-1 and D-02C4A-2 and reserved exact engine paths. New head requires fresh hosted CI and independent review.

Reconciled with main a4babf7, preserving DEV-01 acceptance and regenerating both views. Verified all 17 predecessor checks on 7b0166c. Independent static review identified unresolved write classification, event ordering and bounded lifecycle gaps; integration blocked pending correction.

blockers: Independent review: OPC UA write timeout/errors do not consistently use OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; an uncertain pulse start can skip its compensating release.
Independent review: pending connection-loss events can be overtaken by queued commands; verify disarming before further dispatch.
Independent review: startup failure cleanup and demand/start waits lack engine-enforced deadlines; narrow or correct the termination guarantee and test it.
Exact-head hosted CI and independent review of corrected head required.
